purpose: Decompose the Phase-7 combined wave OOD failure into candidate-law/estimator error, context-tokenization error, recursive requantization error, and irreducible target-token codec error.

frozen_phase7_model_components.features: constant; per channel center, D4 axial radius-1 sum, diagonal radius-1 sum, axial radius-2 sum; generic center monomials u^2, uv, v^2, u^3, u^2v, uv^2, v^3

cases.raw_context_raw_start_continuous: Fit the unchanged 16-feature Phase-7 local map from true raw physical context and roll continuously from the raw last context frame.
cases.raw_context_quantized_start_continuous: Fit from raw context, start from decoded-token last context frame, then roll continuously without further tokenization.
cases.raw_context_quantized_start_requantized: Fit from raw context, start from decoded-token context state, and requantize through the shared RVQ after every recursive step.
cases.quantized_context_quantized_start_contin: Fit from decoded-token context exactly as Phase 7, then roll continuously without further tokenization.
cases.quantized_context_quantized_start_requan: Exact Phase-7 path: fit from decoded-token context and requantize after every recursive step.
cases.target_token_oracle: Quantize/decode the true horizon-3 target and compare it with the raw target.

execution_rule: Run each diagnostic replicate exactly once in an independent process and persist its result immediately. No reruns with the same seeds if interrupted after consumption.

causal_readout.case1_fails: The candidate law family or estimator is itself insufficient even without tokenization.
causal_readout.case1_passes_case2_fails: The decoded token state is too distorted even when coefficients are inferred from raw context.
causal_readout.case2_passes_case3_fails: Recursive requantization is the dominant bottleneck.
causal_readout.cases1_to3_pass_case4_or5_fails: Quantized context corrupts system identification; coefficient estimation from tokenized observations is the dominant bottleneck.
causal_readout.case4_passes_case5_fails: Repeated rollout tokenization is the dominant bottleneck after token-context identification.
causal_readout.oracle_near_or_above_1: The representation itself makes the requested horizon close to or worse than persistence even with perfect target token IDs.

claim_limit: Diagnostic only. This phase locates a failure mechanism; it does not establish a new scientific capability.
